environment.description: Same Rails 7.1 application on ECS Fargate. ALB listener on port 443 configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) passthrough mode using a Trust Store associated with an internal PKI root CA (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/ts-internal-pki/abc123). The listener's mutual_authentication block specifies mode='verify' with ignore_client_certificate_expiry=false. The Trust Store contains only the root CA certificate for the organization's internal certificate authority (CN=InternalOps Root CA, O=AcmeCorp). Client connections without a valid certificate signed by this CA chain receive a TLS handshake failure (no HTTP response is generated). API keys are additionally scoped per client certificate CN via a custom middleware that cross-references the X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Serial-Number header injected by ALB against the api_keys table's allowed_cert_serial column.

config.trust_store_ca: CN=InternalOps Root CA, O=AcmeCorp (internal PKI, not publicly trusted)
config.mtls_mode: verify (strict - connection rejected at TLS layer if no valid client cert)
config.internal_clients: 12 registered service identities with individual client certificates
